title: Brand Agent
description: Reference to a brand agent that provides brand data via MCP

url.description: Brand agent MCP endpoint URL. Callers comparing this URL against another value (e.g., resolving 'is this the brand's declared agent?' against a discovery cache) MUST canonicalize both sides per the AdCP URL canonicalization rules, not byte-equality. See docs/reference/url-canonicalization.

id.description: Agent identifier (useful for logging, multi-tenant DAMs)
